assets.title: Week 11 opener board with one full look and three close-up detail crops
assets.description: A single board that shows one adult fashion garment or sketch in full view plus three close-up crops so students can move from overall observation to design-detail noticing.
assets.notes: Keep the full look and the three close-up crops visible together. Use stable literal keys that match the activity prompts. Avoid clutter, logos, or tiny unreadable labels.

assets.title: Week 11 keyed close-up vocabulary board A to J
assets.description: A clear adult-learning board with ten close-up garment details labeled A to J for explicit image-to-word matching.
assets.notes: Show closures, pockets, decorative details, and construction details clearly enough for mobile viewing. Keep the keys literal and visible. Do not add extra instructional text inside the image.

assets.title: Week 11 scavenger garment with point labels A to H
assets.description: One garment or sketch with eight unambiguous point labels so students can identify visible details and then classify some of them as functional, decorative, or both.
assets.notes: Point labels A to H must be large, clear, and placed exactly on the intended details. Preserve the same point strings in activity answer data and prompt notes.

assets.title: Week 11 reusable detail gallery image A to image D
assets.description: A reusable four-image detail gallery for reading, listening, writing, and speaking. Each gallery image should show one clearly identifiable garment detail with a stable visible key.
assets.notes: Keep image A to image D literal and stable. Use one zipper detail, one embroidery detail, one patch-pocket detail, and one ruffle detail so the reading, listening, writing, and speaking tasks can align tightly.

assets.title: Week 11 numbered detail-identification listening clip
assets.description: One short A2 listening clip with numbered descriptions aligned exactly to the Week 11 reusable detail gallery.
assets.notes: Keep the listening script only in audio_prompts.json. Do not create a separate transcript asset. The gallery labels, numbered script, question labels, options, and correct answers must match exactly.
